title: LJS 51: second look at the unsettled (c) rows of errata.md, two concordant readings with the key's sign count (contribution)

solution.what: 15 of the 43 c rows of errata.md (Bourdeau) re-read from the Penn IIIF 2343 px images. Reader A was Claude Opus 5.5 (not blind), using crop + sign count and sign values from keys_eye. Reader B was Claude Opus (blind), with the crop only and shape options. A row is settled only if the two readings agree. Controls: 3/3 correct on rows already settled. Result: 8 rows to a, 6 to b, 1 still c; 28 not re-read. Rows 4 and 78 are fragile (reader B low confidence). Descriptive, not a validation.
